# ConfirmModal

A modal dialog component that presents a confirmation prompt with an icon, descriptive content, a cancel button, and a primary action button.

```ts
import { ConfirmModal } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

The `visible` prop controls whether the modal is displayed. `onDismiss` is called when the user clicks the cancel button or the modal overlay, and `onAction` is called when the user clicks the action button.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ConfirmModal, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Open Modal
      </Button>
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={visible}
        onDismiss={() => setVisible(false)}
        onAction={() => setVisible(false)}
        actionButtonText="Confirm"
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            Are you sure you want to proceed with this action?
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Icon and Color

Use the `iconName` prop to display a different Cobalt icon, and `iconColor` to override the default icon color.

- `iconName="warning"` — displays a warning icon
- `iconColor` set to a theme token string — overrides the default `secondary500` color

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ConfirmModal, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Open Warning Modal
      </Button>
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={visible}
        onDismiss={() => setVisible(false)}
        onAction={() => setVisible(false)}
        iconName="warning"
        iconColor={theme.warning500}
        actionButtonType="danger"
        actionButtonText="Delete"
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            This action cannot be undone. All selected records will be
            permanently deleted.
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Loading State

Set `isActionButtonLoading` to `true` to show an inline loading spinner on the action button while an async operation is in progress.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ConfirmModal, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleAction = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(false);
      setVisible(false);
    }, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Open Loading Modal
      </Button>
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={visible}
        onDismiss={() => !loading && setVisible(false)}
        onAction={handleAction}
        actionButtonText="Save"
        isActionButtonLoading={loading}
        isDisabled={loading}
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            Click Save to simulate an async operation.
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Custom Cancel Text

Use `cancelButtonText` to replace the default "Cancel" label on the dismiss button — useful for localisation or when the context calls for a more specific label such as "Keep" or "Go back".

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ConfirmModal, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="danger" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Remove agent
      </Button>
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={visible}
        onDismiss={() => setVisible(false)}
        onAction={() => setVisible(false)}
        iconName="trash"
        actionButtonType="danger"
        actionButtonText="Remove"
        cancelButtonText="Keep agent"
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            This agent will be removed from all active schedules. This cannot be
            undone.
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop                        | Type                                   | Default          | Description                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `visible`                   | `boolean`                              | —                | Controls modal visibility                                                       |
| `onDismiss`                 | `() => void`                           | —                | Called when cancel or overlay is clicked                                        |
| `onAction`                  | `() => void`                           | —                | Called when the action button is clicked                                        |
| `content`                   | `ReactNode`                            | —                | Body content of the modal                                                       |
| `actionButtonText`          | `string`                               | —                | Label for the action button                                                     |
| `iconName`                  | `string`                               | `'info_circle'`  | Cobalt icon name displayed at the top                                           |
| `iconColor`                 | `string`                               | `secondary500`   | Icon color (use `useTheme()` tokens)                                            |
| `actionButtonType`          | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'`      | Visual type for the action button                                               |
| `isActionButtonLoading`     | `boolean`                              | `false`          | Shows inline loading spinner on the action button                               |
| `isDisabled`                | `boolean`                              | `false`          | Disables the action button                                                      |
| `cancelButtonText`          | `string`                               | `'Cancel'`       | Label for the cancel button                                                     |
| `data-qa`                   | `string`                               | —                | QA selector (also derives child element selectors)                              |
| `data-component`            | `string`                               | `'ConfirmModal'` | Component identifier                                                            |
